supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Clear lateral extension visible beyond the outer corner of the left eye

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-grey/pinkish muzzle and the dark-pigmented periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Thick lower lip with a distinct structural droop

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small reddish punctate marks or lesions visible across the lower chin area
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive greyish/white hair or depigmentation concentrated around the lower jaw and muzzle
